noResourceCost.label: No Recipe Resource Costs
noResourceCost.description: Removes direct ingredients, category ingredients and water charges from recipes before startup. Recipe requirements display as zero. Requires a game restart. Building, upgrade and other shared inventory costs are unchanged.

infiniteItemUse.label: No Item Consumption
infiniteItemUse.description: Used food, potions, bandages and other supported items stay in your inventory instead of being consumed. Applies live to supported use actions. Recipe ingredients, trades and inventory transfers are unchanged. Some item actions are not supported.

productionTimeMode.label: Recipe Time Mode
productionTimeMode.description: Changing the mode requires a restart. Original mode scales each recipe time while the game runs. Fixed mode applies one duration to every timed recipe at startup.

options.fixed: Restart required: One shared time for all recipes

productionSeconds.label: Production Time in Seconds
productionSeconds.description: Sets the duration used by every timed recipe in fixed mode. Takes effect after a restart.

workshopTimeFactorPercent.label: Production Duration Scale
workshopTimeFactorPercent.description: Applied live to loaded recipe times. At 0%, the shortest timed recipe takes 1 second and other recipes keep their relative times. 100% restores original recipe times. The world speed setting stays unchanged. Changes also affect running production.

groups.label: Resources and Inventory
groups.description: Recipe ingredient and water costs are removed before startup. No Item Consumption prevents supported items from being consumed when used.

groups.label: Production
groups.description: Choose between scaling recipe times as production runs or using one fixed duration for all timed recipes. Only the settings for the selected mode are available.
